systematic_followup.purpose: Find theorem-grade mechanisms missing from the current Dual-Debt state rather than more carrier aliases.

strongest_followup_candidate.name: SCOPED_CARRIER_AUTHORITY_TOKEN
strongest_followup_candidate.thesis: Debt conservation is necessary but not sufficient. Every nontrivial carrier/quotient should also carry an explicit authority scope describing which source-reachable states, readout/query, future continuation language and capability profile its exactness theorem actually covers.

components.ReachContract: Which abstract/carrier states and transitions are proved source-realizable/reachable, or which unreachable states are proved irrelevant.
components.Readout: Exact target predicate/query being preserved, e.g. SAT existence, projected witness, model count, occupancy polynomial.
components.ContinuationLanguage: Exact class of future contexts/operations under which the quotient/congruence proof remains valid.
components.CapabilityDigest: Exact solver/carrier operation profile and verifier/policy/budget version.
components.CarrierAdequacyProof: Independent proof that the carrier is exact for the declared source/readout/continuation scope.
components.ExpiryRule: Any change outside the declared scope marks the authority token STALE until independently revalidated.

strongest_followup_candidate.why_missing_from_dual_debt_v1: Dual-Debt v1.0 tracks Meaning, Representation, Capabilities, debts, liabilities and receipts, but does not separately type carrier semantic authority by source-reachable subset plus frozen continuation/query scope.

evidence_for_source_realizability_axis.key_point: Static minimum incidence-cover existence was explicitly separated from dynamic source-realizable closure; source-realized cover was not allowed to become a hard-core or solver theorem.
Exact state identity and source lift under actual DP semantics were separated. A normal-form preimage could be a valid source lift without being exact post-state identity.
Algebraic carrier relations were not promoted until real frozen source preimages, DP interaction and reconstruction passed independently.
Representation identity/resource profile was separated from semantic authority; predicate fibers must be semantically valid before use.

source_realizability_rule_candidate.name: SOURCE_REALIZABILITY_AUTHORITY
rule: A carrier state may influence an accepted proof trace only if it is linked to the frozen source by an independently replayable construction/preimage receipt, OR an exact theorem proves the unreachable formal states cannot affect the declared readout.
A carrier theorem over a larger algebraic state space does not authorize transitions through source-unrealizable states merely because those states satisfy the carrier grammar.
Reconstruction must return from every accepted terminal carrier state to the original source contract.
source_realizability_rule_candidate.benefit: Allows algorithms to reason only over the actually reachable semantic image when justified, while preventing abstract-state leakage from fictitious carrier states.
source_realizability_rule_candidate.prior_art_boundary: Reachability-aware abstraction, simulation/bisimulation reduction and translation validation are established; the candidate value is the proof-state admission rule combined with Dual-Debt provenance.

evidence_for_continuation_scoped_axis.result: Formula-specific exact future signatures merge boundary rows, while a formula-independent quotient valid for every arbitrary future 3CNF continuation cannot merge distinct boundary assignments.
evidence_for_continuation_scoped_axis.lesson: Universal future-context equivalence can collapse to identity; useful exact compression may require a frozen continuation/query contract.

Structural distinctions may be dropped only after a proof that they are irrelevant to the final SAT-existence readout; open connected components require explicit boundary messages rather than blind dropping.
Exact boundary messages can discharge tractable internals before physical disconnection, but unsupported mixed 3CNF remains OPEN.
Disconnected OPEN cores can remain factorized without cross-product materialization while connected unsupported interaction remains OPEN.

continuation_authority_rule_candidate.name: CONTINUATION_SCOPED_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY
rule: Every lossy quotient/compression declares an exact Readout and ContinuationLanguage.
Two concrete states may merge only when the adequacy certificate proves indistinguishability for that declared future contract.
A later operation/context outside ContinuationLanguage cannot reuse the quotient as semantic authority; the token becomes STALE and requires revalidation, refinement or exact expansion.
Changing only scheduler preference inside the frozen continuation contract does not invalidate authority.
OPEN-vault keys should include the authority-scope digest in addition to capability/core digests.
continuation_authority_rule_candidate.benefit: Permits stronger exact compression than universal contextual equivalence while preventing formula-specific/query-specific quotients from leaking into unsupported future operations.
continuation_authority_rule_candidate.prior_art_boundary: Property-specific abstract-domain quotients, contextual equivalence and query-driven compilation are established. No primitive novelty claimed.

blind_discovery_noninterference_layer.name: SOURCE_BOUND_DISCOVERY_NONINTERFERENCE

checks: candidate input bytes identical across NO_OBSERVER/READ_ONLY/HOSTILE_COPY observer modes
candidate/checker outputs identical across observer modes
target metadata canary absent from candidate-visible payload
unsafe shared mutable object negative control detected

evidence.source: APMA Stage C blind authority audit
evidence.key_point: Candidate/checker and blind authority were frozen before blind execution; exact positive admission and fail-closed negative refusal were independently replayed.
Family labels and expected quotient vocabulary were forbidden to discovery; a generic choice-conflict relation was discovered on a frozen blinded population with exact reconstruction/certification.

blind_discovery_noninterference_layer.integration: Every future carrier-discovery/selector experiment should receive a source-bound raw payload plus frozen A_scope only. Observer/metadata paths must be noninterfering and delayed labels must not alter candidate bytes.
blind_discovery_noninterference_layer.benefit: Reduces researcher/agent leakage and prevents target-aware rediscovery from being mistaken for generic induction.

factorized_computation_lesson.name: SEMANTIC_FUNCTION_COUNT_NE_REQUIRED_COMPUTATION_STATE_COUNT

evidence.source: BA4 factorized k-bit persistent identity channel
evidence.key_point: 2^k semantic boundary states were represented componentwise with O(k) metadata and no boundary-vector enumeration when the relation factored.

evidence.source: BA21 proof-carrying disjoint-block OR compressed projection
evidence.key_point: An implicit 2^64 prime-clause object was handled by a linear-size factorized DBO descriptor without expand-then-compress.
Exact model-count/SAT processing used states bounded by active interface size kappa; 2^64 compiled residual functions in the positive control were not materialized.

factorized_computation_lesson.kernel_implication: Do not use the number of exact residual functions, quotient classes or possible boundary assignments alone as a representation-pressure lower-bound witness. The hostile must also defeat allowed factorized computation under the frozen authority scope.
factorized_computation_lesson.prior_art_boundary: Treewidth/factor-graph DP and knowledge compilation already establish the underlying idea.

engineering_only_findings.name: EXACT_CONTENT_ADDRESSED_SPILL_RELOAD
engineering_only_findings.use: Permit exact externalization/reload of large proof messages to lower active-memory peaks while charging disk bytes, replay and serialization work.

engineering_only_findings.name: PREFIX_CLOSURE_MICROSTEP_AUTHORITY
engineering_only_findings.use: Producer proposes; independently verified invariant/prefix-closure theorem decides authority. Useful pattern for atomic macro admission.

negative_design_lessons.lesson: Polynomially constructible support constraints are useless as SAT transformations if they are not semantics-preserving. Incidence/debt pressure cannot be paid by adding arbitrary helpful constraints.
negative_design_lessons.evidence: 1211/1212 targets changed truth function and 63/1212 changed SAT status under the non-semantic support cover; later exact semantic binary cover had explicit no-go states.

negative_design_lessons.lesson: A universally complete typed interaction layer can simply re-express general 3SAT. The architecture should search for certified scoped interaction laws and return OPEN, not pursue an unrestricted universal interaction carrier without a theorem.

proposed_next_formalization_if_authorize.name: U_PAIR_1J_SCOPED_CARRIER_AUTHORITY_AND_SOURCE_REALIZABILITY_ADDENDUM
theorem_candidates: SA1_SOURCE_REALIZABILITY_SOUNDNESS: every authority-bearing carrier transition either has a replayable source-preimage lineage or a theorem excluding unreachable states from the declared readout.
SA2_QUERY_CONTINUATION_ADEQUACY: carrier equality/merge preserves the declared readout under every continuation in the frozen ContinuationLanguage.
SA3_SCOPE_STALENESS: changing source identity, readout, continuation language or capability digest invalidates reuse of the old authority token until revalidated.
SA4_SCOPED_OPEN_VAULT_SAFETY: an OPEN refusal may be reused only under identical core+capability+authority-scope digests.

SA5_SCOPED_TERMINAL_COMPOSITION: DD5 terminal soundness plus valid source/continuation authority yields a source-sound terminal without authority leakage from unreachable or out-of-scope carrier states.
proposed_next_formalization_if_authorize.purpose: Strengthen Dual-Debt admission without inventing a third debt class.

novelty_boundary.distinctive_composition_candidate: Dual-debt proof state + capability passport + source-realizability admission + continuation-scoped semantic authority + capability/scope-stale OPEN memory + blind noninterfering discovery.
